dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Is it time to rest already? Very well.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: This is all very novel — both this stage, and the foes we face. And I was hoping we could play a while longer...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Hmm? This isn't a game? Huh. What is it, then...?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Rosalyne taught me the essentials of gift-giving. It's not about your preferences, but those of the other person.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I've heard that those lovely magical ladies enjoy creating "tasks" and setting up trials...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Perhaps preparing a challenge that will require substantial effort to complete is a suitable way of repaying their kindness... It would make them happy, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Have you looked up? The bookshelves above our heads are inverted, and there are carpets, tables, and chairs on the ceiling...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: But what if we shift our perspective?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Perhaps that is the true floor, and we are simply suspended in the sky by the magic of those sagacious ladies.
